Some manufacturers close background apps to save battery, which would cut the receiver connection with the screen off. Follow these steps once on your phone.

1. Tap “App battery settings”, open Battery and choose “Unrestricted”.\n2. Don\'t close TopoPhone from recent apps while you work.\n3. If you use the phone\'s battery saver, turn it off during the working day.
Settings > Battery > Background usage limits: if TopoPhone is in “Sleeping apps” or “Deep sleeping apps”, remove it and add it to “Never sleeping apps”.
Settings > Apps > Manage apps > TopoPhone: turn on “Autostart” and, under “Battery saver”, choose “No restrictions”. In recent apps, long-press TopoPhone and lock it.
Settings > Battery > App launch: turn off “Manage automatically” for TopoPhone and keep “Auto-launch”, “Secondary launch” and “Run in background” on.
Settings > Battery > More settings > Optimise battery use: choose “Don\'t optimise” for TopoPhone and allow its background activity. In recent apps, lock it.
